2.
Petitioner is before this Court praying to enlarge him on bail in Cr.No.10/2024 of Kolar Women Police Station, Kolar, registered for offence punishable under Section 363 of IPC.

3. On completion of investigation, charge sheet is filed against the petitioner for offences punishable under Section 363, 376(2)(N), 212 and 506 IPC, Section 6 of NC: 2025:KHC:30595 HC-KAR POCSO Act, 2012 and Section 9 of Prohibition of Child Marriage Act, 2006.
4. The trial is in progress and it is submitted that the case is listed on 20.8.2025 for arguments.
Hence, the trial is at the fag end.
